development_simplicity.scope: Require every two-sided 95% video-bootstrap interval to lie within its one-sided noninferiority margin. Conditional fixed-fit evidence; not training-seed or selection-adjusted.

bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fixed fitted models and masks; not training-seed or selection-adjusted uncertainty
bootstrap.development: Independent within-fold video resampling, then equal fold mean
bootstrap.confirmation: Same video resamples across models, conditions and training seeds, then equal seed mean

three_arm_scope: Descriptive same-fold comparison; selection concerns none versus span only; no independent new benchmark.
